review_basis: Author inspection of the complete candidate fact definitions, formulas, assumptions and quoted source paragraphs, after generation and before executing these reference cases; not independent legal adjudication. Candidate chosen for its explicit separate product classifications and later-notice predicate. Other readings remain retained.
additional_assumptions: The assessed requirement belongs to Part III of Schedule 10; frozen case facts did not explicitly name this scope predicate.
Product labels are stipulated classifications, not real bank classification results.
This conditional operational reading treats the announced commencement as applicable without adding a gazettal precondition; the rival reading remains unresolved.
Java FALSE is a failure of this exemption predicate, not a margin-breach decision.
